A new authenticated activation receives current surrounding text, but has UnknownStart and no locally observed suffix. ManualToggleV3 rejects before the existing exact-tail executor. decision: Permit an explicit manual gesture to acquire a bounded exact source from the current authenticated, settled field after fresh focus, using the existing reducer-owned ExactManualSourceSnapshotReceipt and exact-tail handoff. Acquisition requires an untouched source-free activation, current surrounding callback, collapsed caret at text end, non-sensitive content, no composition, pending replay or quarantine. Any possible-mutation key or broader revocation spends fresh-focus eligibility; Shift observations do not. Keep UnknownStart and observed_suffix_chars zero. A successful gesture may authorize only the existing exact manual replay and its existing layout handoff, never autocorrection, learning, a historical word or a selection edit.
